name: Sue Jones
occupation: Carbon County commissioner (current term continues past 2026). The Rawlins Times described her as commission chairperson in December 2024.
prior_offices: Carbon County commissioner (won the November 2024 general election; listed on the official commissioners page)
background: Sue Jones is a Carbon County commissioner. She won the November 2024 general election, and the official commissioners page lists her as a member. The Rawlins Times described her as commission chairperson when the board accepted Clerk Gwynn Bartlett's resignation in December 2024. She was not on the 2026 county-commission ballot.

sources.name: Rawlins Times, Dec. 18, 2024, Carbon County clerk resigns, replacement process begins
